span.normalized: Other expense related to the conversions and adjustments to the Convertible Notes was impacted by the Company’s higher stock price during 2025. The Company also recognized deferred debt issuance costs as a result of placing the syndication process on hold upon the termination of the FCA Offtake Agreement. The increase in other expense, net in the current period was partially offset by the absence of a loss on sales and a write-down of raw material inventory in the current year, compared to the same period of the prior year.
